comparison.objective: Remove two loose metal discs from a harness board, then route a cable along a marked line with its plug in an outline.
comparison.physical_skill: FOD pickup and binning followed by deformable cable routing; cable must not contact remaining debris.
comparison.success_condition: Both discs are in the red bin and the cable follows the line with its plug in the endpoint outline; routing tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: This shares physical debris collection, but its central ability is pre-existing FOD clearance plus cable routing. The candidate must first create fragments through controlled coaxial impact while preserving inserts, then recover all four; that is a meaningfully different tested ability.
